## Data Source & Pre-processing

The dataset for this analysis is sourced from the [YGOPRODeck API](https://ygoprodeck.com/api-guide/), an open community resource providing historical card statistics, banlist records, and gameplay metadata under fair-use community licensing.

The complete raw API payload contains lengthy text descriptions, localized strings, and high-resolution image links that push the file size well above 20 MB. To adhere to repository storage constraints (under 5 MB) and enable fast, reproducible renders, the raw endpoint (`/api/v7/cardinfo.php?misc=yes&format=tcg`) was queried and pre-processed prior to commit:

1. **Size Optimization:** Non-essential descriptive text (`desc`) and nested image URLs were removed.
2. **Feature Extraction:** Nested dictionary objects inside the raw `misc_info` field were unnested into dedicated numeric columns: `views`, `upvotes`, and `downvotes`.
3. **Net Sentiment Calculation:** A derived metric, `net_votes = upvotes - downvotes`, was computed to quantify community card approval.
4. **Scope:** Filtered to standard TCG tournament-legal sets, producing a streamlined 1.8 MB snapshot stored at `data/ygo_staples_data.csv`.
